title: Nsɛnkyerɛnne a Ɛwɔ Abo Mu
intro: Wɔ asaase bi a na wɔasen mmepɔ wɔ afie mu no, ɔbɔfoɔ bi de anwanwadeɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ bi a ɛfiri Allah hɔ baa hɔ. Nkurɔfo no hwehwɛɛ adanse, na wonyaa abɔde bi fii ɔbotan a ɛyɛ den mu. Nanso wɔn ahantan no maa wobuu kɔkɔbɔ no so, na ɛsɔɔ wɔn nkrabea ano.
clues: Wɔsomaa me kɔɔ nnipa bi a wɔtete atrae a wɔasen fi mmepɔw so mu.
Wɔtoo me mpoa sɛ memfa sɛnkyerɛnne mmra, enti miyii yoma fii ɔbotan bi mu bae.
Mehyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmma yoma no nnom nnom na wɔmmpira no.
Wɔyɛɛ asoɔden na wɔbɔɔ yoma no asen, na wɔbuu me kɔkɔbɔ no so.
Mebɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ asotwe bɛba nnansa akyi.
Anɔpa no, ɔtopae a ano yɛ den sɛee wɔn, nanso wogyee me ne m’akyidifo nkwa.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
